Bids, Tenders, Contracts

Grey County issues requests for tenders and requests for proposals to ensure a competitive procurement process. 

Table of Contents

Public Purchasing Portal

Grey County's Request for Tenders (RFT), Request for Proposals (RFP), and other procurement opportunities are available online and can be viewed free of charge. Competitive opportunities can be found by clicking the link below:

Click to Access Public Purchasing Portal

If you are a business owner that would like to be added to a database used by County of Grey purchasers, please register through the Public Purchasing Portal. When registering, businesses are strongly encouraged to select their NIGP commodity / service codes in order to receive email notifications from the county of opportunities that match their services.

View Registration

If anyone has questions, or need assistance updating their profile with the proper commodity codes, please contact Mike Alguire.

Current Purchasing Opportunities
Reference #: RFI-FIN-02-26. Name: Financial Management Software

Description: Accounting Software request for information as disclosed in the RFI document. Project closes Aug 06, 2026 2:00 PM EDT.

Reference #: RFT-EDTC-05-26. Name: Replacement of HVAC Unit Ventilators with Air Source Heat Pumps at Sydenham Campus

Description: A general description of the work includes:
Supply of all labour, materials, services, transportation, and incidentals required to remove existing classroom ducted unit ventilators and replace with new, not previously used; ducted, single-zone heat pumps compatible with Siemens Desigo automation.
Supply and install any flooring, vent coverings, drywall, and masonry to match interior and exterior aesthetics. Project closes Aug 21, 2026 2:00 PM EDT.

Certificate of Insurance

The County of Grey utilizes a Standardized Certificate of Insurance (COI) form and it can be found at the link below.

Individuals and organizations who supply goods and services to the County are required to provide evidence of insurance as part of the terms and conditions of a contract, purchase order, permit, or other form of agreement.

If you have any questions regarding Certificates of Insurance, please contact the requestor.

This form is the preferred Certificate of Insurance accepted by The County. The form is to be completed by your insurer or their authorized representative. Once completed, please email to mike.alguire [at] grey.ca (Mike Alguire.) 

Standardized COI for Grey County

Sign up for Grey County updates

Grey County has launched the Grey County Connection, our new monthly public newsletter. The Connection is the new way we’re delivering news, updates and opportunities directly to your inbox each month.

Sign up to receive the Grey County Connection, or any of our other newsletters, below. You can also select from other areas of interest, ranging from weekly public events to automated roads notifications to regular departmental updates.
